items.title: AI Coding 提速之后，如何补上稳定性“最后一公里”？快手柯南 AI 实践
items.raw_excerpt: AI Coding 正在显著提升代码生产效率，但线上告警、根因定位、止损和修复等稳定性环节并未同步提速。更值得警惕的是，缺乏全局上下文的 AI 可能沿着“最小阻力路径”消除表面现象，却留下跨工程、跨系统的稳定性隐患。 当 AI 开始规模化生产代码，谁来承接随之增长的线上问题，正成为 AI Native 研发体系必须补上的“最后一公里”。

title_i18n.zh: AI Coding 提速之后，如何补上稳定性“最后一公里”？快手柯南 AI 实践
title_i18n.en: After AI coding speeds up, how do we close the last mile of stability? Kuaishou Conan AI practice.
title_i18n.es: Tras la aceleración del AI Coding, ¿cómo cubrir la última milla de la estabilidad? La práctica de Conan AI en Kuaishou

excerpt_i18n.zh: AI Coding 正在显著提升代码生产效率，但线上告警、根因定位、止损和修复等稳定性环节并未同步提速。更值得警惕的是，缺乏全局上下文的 AI 可能沿着“最小阻力路径”消除表面现象，却留下跨工程、跨系统的稳定性隐患。 当 AI 开始规模化生产代码，谁来承接随之增长的线上问题，正成为 AI Native 研发体系必须补上的“最后一公里”。
excerpt_i18n.en: AI coding is significantly boosting code production efficiency, but stability work such as online alerts, root cause analysis, impact mitigation, and fixes has not accelerated in tandem. More concerning, AI lacking global context may follow the path of least resistance to eliminate surface symptoms while leaving cross-engineering and cross-system stability risks. As AI begins to produce code at scale, who will handle the resulting growth in online issues is becoming the last mile that AI-native R&D systems must close.

items.title: The State of AI Antibody Design
items.raw_excerpt: This Science blog post surveys the current state of AI-driven antibody design, covering generative protein models, structure prediction, and sequence-based methods used to discover and optimize antibody candidates. It highlights remaining bottlenecks—experimental validation throughput, developability and immunogenicity, and the scarcity of high-quality wet-lab data—concluding that AI accelerates early-stage exploration but does not yet replace experimental screening.

excerpt_i18n.en: This Science blog post surveys the current state of AI-driven antibody design, covering generative protein models, structure prediction, and sequence-based methods used to discover and optimize antibody candidates.
